reason: The ceramic blocks are the apparent source of root medium, but their required preparation is not yet clear.
expectation: The inspection should identify how to prepare the ceramic for the beds.

effect: The blocks have become washed, checked porous medium ready for the beds.
reaction: The leach check and removal of fines make the preparation feel practical.
reason: The prepared medium belongs in the empty growing beds.
expectation: The beds will be filled with clean porous medium.

effect: The beds now contain porous medium, and the remaining goal is to water the shared loop.
reaction: The dry beds make the next step clear.
reason: The drinking water supply can fill the unwatered beds through their connected system.
expectation: Water will enter the beds and shared irrigation loop.

effect: The shared irrigation loop is operating, though the lettuce shelf still needs a wick; the chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The distinction between the watered beds and the still-dry lettuce shelf was a useful detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the ceramic medium was most worthwhile: washing out fines and checking leaching connected the combination to root aeration and material safety.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the beds was straightforward and less informative on its own, although it was necessary progress.

surprise.text: The lettuce shelf remained dry after the shared loop was watered and still needs a wick; the three crops do not all receive water in the same way.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. I initially needed an inspection to learn how the blocks became medium, but the resulting preparation had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the lettuce wick and crops are established; the irrigation detail left a useful open question.
